## 1. Architecture Overview

All channel creation forms share a common component tree. The channel-specific behaviour comes from configuration fetched from the integration service API, not from separate per-channel components (with some exceptions for WhatsApp embedded signup and Facebook OAuth).

```
ChannelFormLayoutContainer        ← routing, tab management, layout options
  └── ChannelFormInfoContainer    ← Redux-connected logic (create/update/upload)
        └── ChannelFormInfo       ← Class component — renders all fields, validates, submits
              ├── IntegrateChannel / IntegrateChannelSignup  (WhatsApp embedded signup)

├── FacebookPagesListContainer               (Facebook / Instagram OAuth)
              └── Dynamic fields from configParams         (all other channels)
```

**Integration details API (fetched on mount):**
```
GET /api/v1/im/integrationServices/:integrationServiceId
```
Returns `configParams` array that defines all form fields — their type, label, required status, options, and ordering.

**Channel constants:**

```js
// src/constants/ServiceConstants.js
WHATSAPP_APPNAME    = 'WHATSAPP'
TELEGRAM_APPNAME    = 'TELEGRAM'
LINE_APPNAME        = 'LINE'
WECHAT_APPNAME      = 'WECHAT'
WECOM_APPNAME       = 'WECOM'
INSTAGRAM_APPNAME   = 'INSTAGRAM'
FBMESSENGER_APPNAME = 'FACEBOOKMESSENGER'
IMTALK_APPNAME      = 'IM_TALK'
```

## 2. Shared Form Infrastructure

### 2.1 ChannelFormInfo.js

[src/components/ChannelFormInfo/ChannelFormInfo.js](jsapps/imclient/src/components/ChannelFormInfo/ChannelFormInfo.js)

Large class component (~1700 lines). Handles all channels.

#### Field types supported

```js
this.expectedInputTypes = {
  STRING:           'text',
  NUMBER:           'number',
  URL:              'url',
  EMAIL:            'email',
  PHONE:            'number',
  OPTIONS:          'select',
  PASSWORD:         'password',
  DATE:             'date',
  TIME:             'time',
  DATETIME:         'dateTime',
  BOOLEAN:          'boolean',
  SYSTEM_DEFINED:   'systemDefined',
#### Validation rules (hardcoded, channel-aware)

| Field | Rule | Error i18n key |
|---|---|---|
| Channel `name` | Required | `zohoim.channel.form.field.mandatory.<type>` |
| Channel `name` | Regex: `^[a-zA-Z0-9_+?!.,:@;\u0080-\uFFFF\s()]+$` | `zohoim.setup.label.rule.special.notallowed` |
| Any required configParam | Non-empty | `zohoim.channel.form.field.mandatory.<type>` |

| WeChat `TOKEN` | Length 3–32 | `zohoim.channel.wechat.token.field.limit.error` |
| WeChat `AES_KEY` | Exactly 43 chars | `zohoim.channel.wechat.aeskey.field.limit.error` |
| `departmentId` | Must be selected | `zohoim.channel.form.field.mandatory.select` |
| Facebook `FACEBOOK_USER` | Required BUT skipped if FACEBOOKMESSENGER (page trumps user) | _(skipped)_ |

Errors are displayed inline below the field via `ValidationMessage` component using `validationPalette='mandatory'`.

On validation failure: `failureLayoutCallBack()` is called, page scrolls to the first error field.

#### Form submission flow

[src/containers/ChannelFormInfoContainer/ChannelFormInfoContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/containers/ChannelFormInfoContainer/ChannelFormInfoContainer.js)

Functional Redux container. Key responsibilities:

- Calls `createIMChannel` / `updateIMChannel` actions
- Uploads channel photo via `uploadChannelPhoto` (separate call after channel create)
- Updates department association via `associateDepartmentToChannel`
- Shows agent association alert (`agentAssociationAlert: true`) after create
- Routes back after success
**Common error handling in SetupActions:**

| Error code | Channel | i18n key |
|---|---|---|
| `SAME_BOT_CONFIGURATION` | Telegram (create) | `zohoim.setup.channel.creation.telegram.same.bot` |
| `SAME_BOT_CONFIGURATION` | Telegram (update) | `zohoim.setup.channel.updation.telegram.same.bot` |
| `FORBIDDEN` | All | `zohoim.security.common.error` |
| Generic API error | All | API `errorMessage` value directly |

## 3. Channel: WhatsApp

**App name constant:** `WHATSAPP` (`WHATSAPP_APPNAME`)

### 3.1 Routing

| Page | Route |
|---|---|
| Integration landing | `/settings/:orgName/whatsapp/:customFilter` |
| Create channel | `/settings/:orgName/whatsapp/:customFilter/channels/new` |
| Edit channel | `/settings/:orgName/whatsapp/:customFilter/channels/edit/:channelId` |
| Tabs (edit) | `channels` / `templates` / `sandbox` |
### 3.2 Component files

| Component | File |
|---|---|
| Integration UI | [src/containers/WhatsAppIntegrationContainer/WhatsAppIntegrationContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/containers/WhatsAppIntegrationContainer/WhatsAppIntegrationContainer.js) |

| Routing wrapper | [src/containers/WhatsappIntegrateContainer/WhatsappIntegrateContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/containers/WhatsappIntegrateContainer/WhatsappIntegrateContainer.js) |
| Embedded signup | [src/components/IntegrateChannelSignup/IntegrateChannelSignup.js](jsapps/imclient/src/components/IntegrateChannelSignup/IntegrateChannelSignup.js) |
| Form | [src/components/ChannelFormInfo/ChannelFormInfo.js](jsapps/imclient/src/components/ChannelFormInfo/ChannelFormInfo.js) |

| Constant | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `EMBEDDED_SIGNUP_TRIGGER` | Sent TO iframe — starts the Meta OAuth popup |
| `EMBEDDED_SIGNUP_SUCCESS` | Received FROM iframe — Meta signup completed |
| `EMBEDDED_SIGNUP_FAILURE` | Received FROM iframe — Meta signup failed/cancelled |

**BSP Migration variant:**  
Same flow but `postMessage` includes `{ featureType: WA_BSP_MIGRATION }`. On success, opens `WhatsAppBspMigrationPopup` instead of the normal success callback.

### 3.4 Form fields (configParams)

| Field name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WABA_ID` | `OPTIONS_COMPUTED` | Yes | WhatsApp Business Account ID — dropdown loaded from embedded signup result |
| `PHONE_NUMBER` | `OPTIONS_COMPUTED` | Yes | Phone numbers for selected WABA — reloaded when WABA_ID changes |
| `name` | `STRING` | Yes | User-defined channel display name |

Fields on **edit** only:
- `WHATSAPP_NUMBER` — formatted display of current phone number with country code
- Business profile fields (display name, about, website, address)

### 3.5 Validation errors

| Condition | Message |
|---|---|
| WABA ID differs from embedded signup result | `zohoim.setup.whatsapp.integration.alert.title.waba.id.differs` |
| Phone number empty | Standard mandatory field error |
| Number verification failed | `NUMBER_STATUS_FAIL` state shown inline |

### 3.6 Error cases

| Error | UI |
|---|---|
| Embedded signup failure | `integrationFailureCallback` → shows `integFailureAlert` with custom props |
| Payment restriction | Banner: `zohoim.setup.whatsapp.restriction.banner.text` |
| Permission denied | Permission alert shown, form disabled |
| Generic API error | Toast via `showSuccessFailureMessage` |

### 3.7 Success case

1. `EMBEDDED_SIGNUP_SUCCESS` received from iframe
2. `updateWhatsAppAccount` called with WABA + phone data
3. `integrationSuccessCallback` called
4. Form auto-populates `WABA_ID` and `PHONE_NUMBER` dropdowns
5. User fills channel `name` and clicks **Create**
6. `POST /api/v1/im/channels` with payload
7. Agent association alert shown
8. Navigate to channel list

**Success toast:** Agent association workflow triggers — no separate success toast for creation.  
**Update success toast:** `zohoim.channel.updated.msg`

### 3.8 Special features

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| Sandbox mode | `isSandBox: true` in payload; configurable in Sandbox tab |
| Co-existence | `meta: [{ name: 'CO_EXISTENCE', value: true }]` when `isOnBizApp = true` |
| Business profile | Separate edit tab — photo, description, website, address |
| BSP migration | Separate "Migrate" button, uses same iframe with `WA_BSP_MIGRATION` feature flag |

| Communication modes | WhatsApp Calls tab (if `isWhatsAppCallsEnabled`) |
| Number status tracking | `NUMBER_STATUS_ABSENT` / `NUMBER_STATUS_PRESENT` / `NUMBER_STATUS_FAIL` |

## 4. Channel: Telegram

**App name constant:** `TELEGRAM` (`TELEGRAM_APPNAME`)

### 4.1 Component files

Uses shared `ChannelFormInfo` + `ChannelFormInfoContainer`.  
No embedded signup. No OAuth. Pure form submission.

### 4.2 Form fields (configParams from API)

| Field name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BOT_AUTH_TOKEN` | `PASSWORD` | Yes | Telegram bot token — masked/encrypted input |
| `IM_DOMAIN` | `URL` | Yes | Webhook domain URL |
| `name` | `STRING` | Yes | Channel display name |

### 4.3 Validation

- `BOT_AUTH_TOKEN`: Required. Standard mandatory check.
- `IM_DOMAIN`: Required. Type `url` — browser-level URL format check.
- `name`: Required + special character regex.

### 4.4 Error cases

| Error | Source | Message |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate bot token | Server — `SAME_BOT_CONFIGURATION` | `zohoim.setup.channel.creation.telegram.same.bot` (create) |
| Duplicate bot token | Server — `SAME_BOT_CONFIGURATION` | `zohoim.setup.channel.updation.telegram.same.bot` (update) |
| Generic | Server | API `errorMessage` field |

Error displayed via `showSuccessFailureMessage` as a toast notification.

### 4.5 Success case

1. Form submit → `POST /api/v1/im/channels`
2. `successCallback` → `submitStatus: 'success'` (shown on button for 1.35s)
3. `agentAssociationAlert: true` → agent association dialog shown
4. Navigate back to channel list

### 4.6 Edit page tabs

`CHANNEL_INFO`, `CHANNEL_AGENTS_ASSOCIATION`, `MESSAGE_WIDGET`

## 5. Channel: LINE

**App name constant:** `LINE` (`LINE_APPNAME`)

### 5.1 Component files

Uses shared `ChannelFormInfo` + `ChannelFormInfoContainer`.  
Fields come entirely from `GET /api/v1/im/integrationServices/LINE`.

### 5.2 Form fields

Fetched dynamically from API. All configParams defined by the server. Includes:
- Channel `name` (STRING, required)
- LINE-specific auth/webhook params (from API response)

### 5.3 Validation

- Standard required-field checks from `configParams.isRequired`
- Channel name special character check

### 5.4 Error cases

- Generic API errors → toast via `showSuccessFailureMessage`
- No LINE-specific error codes identified in code

### 5.5 Success case

Same pattern as Telegram — success on button, agent association alert, navigate to list.

### 5.6 Edit page tabs

`CHANNEL_INFO`, `CHANNEL_AGENTS_ASSOCIATION`, `MESSAGE_WIDGET`

## 6. Channel: WeChat

**App name constant:** `WECHAT` (`WECHAT_APPNAME`)

### 6.1 Component files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| [src/components/ChannelFormInfo/ChannelFormInfo.js](jsapps/imclient/src/components/ChannelFormInfo/ChannelFormInfo.js) | Form (with WeChat-specific validation) |
| [src/util/WeChatIPs.js](jsapps/imclient/src/util/WeChatIPs.js) | IP whitelist list for WeChat servers |

### 6.2 Form fields

| Field name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WEBHOOK_URL` | `URL` (read-only, system-defined) | — | Auto-generated; shown with **Copy** button |
| `TOKEN` | `STRING` | Yes | Validation token for WeChat webhook; must be 3–32 chars |
| `AES_KEY` | `STRING` | Yes | Encryption key; exactly 43 chars; shown with **Copy** button |

| `OPEN_KFID` | `STRING` | No | Customer service account ID; shown only on creation page |
| `name` | `STRING` | Yes | Channel display name |

Field info tooltips:
- `zohoim.channel.wechat.webhook.field.info`
- `zohoim.channel.wechat.token.field.info`
- `zohoim.channel.wechat.aeskey.field.info`

### 6.3 WeChat-specific validation (hardcoded in `validate()`)

WeChat requires the Zoho IM server IPs to be whitelisted in the WeChat account settings. These IPs are provided via `WeChatIPs.js` and displayed to the user during setup.

### 6.5 Error cases

| Condition | Message |
|---|---|
| TOKEN length < 3 or > 32 | `zohoim.channel.wechat.token.field.limit.error` |
| AES_KEY length ≠ 43 | `zohoim.channel.wechat.aeskey.field.limit.error` |
| Generic API error | Toast via `showSuccessFailureMessage` |

### 6.6 Success case

Same standard flow — `POST /api/v1/im/channels`, success on button, agent association, navigate.

### 6.7 Edit page tabs

`CHANNEL_INFO`, `CHANNEL_AGENTS_ASSOCIATION`, `MESSAGE_WIDGET`

## 7. Channel: WeCom

**App name constant:** `WECOM` (`WECOM_APPNAME`)

### 7.1 Component files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| [src/containers/WeComFormListContainer/WeComFormListContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/containers/WeComFormListContainer/WeComFormListContainer.js) | Service account list |

| [src/containers/WeComParentAccountListContainer/WeComParentAccountListContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/containers/WeComParentAccountListContainer/WeComParentAccountListContainer.js) | Corp (organization) list |

### 7.2 Form fields

| Field name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WECOM_CORP_ID` | `OPTIONS` (dropdown) | Yes | WeCom Corporation/Organization ID — fetched from WeCom org list |
| `WECOM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` | `OPTIONS_COMPUTED` (dynamic dropdown) | Yes | Customer service account — reloaded when `WECOM_CORP_ID` changes |
| `name` | `STRING` | Yes | Channel display name |

**Dependent field logic:** When `WECOM_CORP_ID` changes, `WECOM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` is reset and its options are re-fetched using the selected corp ID.

**Display list:** Both fields only shown on the **creation** page; hidden on edit.

**Config param reordering:** The first two configParams from the API response are swapped in the UI to show CORP_ID before SERVICE_ACCOUNT.

### 7.3 Validation

- Both fields required — standard mandatory check
- Channel name special character check

### 7.4 Error cases

| Condition | Message |
|---|---|
| License expired (server) | `WECOM_LICENSE_EXPIRED` reply status → inline restriction |
| Trial expired (server) | `WECOM_TRAIL_EXPIRED` reply status → inline restriction |
| Generic | Toast via `showSuccessFailureMessage` |

### 7.5 Success case

Same standard flow.

## 8. Channel: Instagram

**App name constant:** `INSTAGRAM` (`INSTAGRAM_APPNAME`)

### 8.1 Component files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| [src/containers/FacebookPagesListContainer/FacebookPagesListContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/containers/FacebookPagesListContainer/FacebookPagesListContainer.js) | Page/account selector with Facebook SDK |
| [src/util/FBMessengerUtils.js](jsapps/imclient/src/util/FBMessengerUtils.js) | Page status utilities |

### 8.2 Meta service classification

| Field name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `INSTAGRAM_USER` | `OPTIONS_COMPUTED` | Instagram user account |
| `INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` | `OPTIONS_COMPUTED` | Business account linked to the user |
| `CURRENT_STATUS` | `SYSTEM_DEFINED` | Internal — tracks page connection status (`PAGE_ADDED` etc.) |
| `name` | `STRING` | Channel display name |

### 8.4 OAuth / Page connection flow

**Page actions:**
- `addpage` — connect a new Instagram account/page
- `enablepermission` — re-grant permissions (when `PERMISSION_REVOKED`)
- `reauth` — re-authenticate (when `ACCESSTOKEN_EXPIRED`)

### 8.5 Page status values (`CURRENT_STATUS` configParam)

| Status | Meaning | UI Impact |
|---|---|---|
| `PAGE_ADDED` | Page successfully connected | Message Widget tab enabled in edit view |
| `PERMISSION_REVOKED` | App permissions removed | Restriction shown; "Enable Permission" action available |
| `ACCESSTOKEN_EXPIRED` | OAuth token expired | Restriction shown; "Re-authenticate" action available |

### 8.6 Validation

- `INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`: Required (displayed as `zohoim.messenger.field.facebook_page.label` for Meta services)
- Channel name: required + regex

### 8.7 Error cases

| Condition | Message |
|---|---|
| Permission revoked | `zohoim.messenger.page.permission.revoked.no.operation` |
| Auth expired | `zohoim.messenger.page.auth.expired.no.operation` |
| Page action cancelled | `zohoim.instagram.page.action.addpage.cancelled` |
| Access denied | `zohoim.facebook.page.action.access_denied` |
| Generic | API `errorMessage` |

### 8.8 Success case

1. OAuth completes → page added to dropdown
2. User selects page, fills channel name, clicks **Create**
3. `POST /api/v1/im/channels`
4. Agent association alert
5. Navigate to channel list

**Edit page:** Message Widget tab appears when `CURRENT_STATUS === PAGE_ADDED`.

### 8.9 Edit page tabs

`CHANNEL_INFO`, `CHANNEL_AGENTS_ASSOCIATION` + `MESSAGE_WIDGET` (only when `pageStatus === 'PAGE_ADDED'`)

## 9. Channel: Facebook Messenger

**App name constant:** `FACEBOOKMESSENGER` (`FBMESSENGER_APPNAME`)

### 9.1 Component files

Same as Instagram — shares `FacebookPagesListContainer` and `useFBMessenger` hook.

| Constants | Value |
|---|---|
| `FACEBOOK_USER` | `'FACEBOOK_USER'` |
| `FACEBOOK_PAGE` | `'FACEBOOK_PAGE'` |

### 9.2 Form fields

| Field name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FACEBOOK_USER` | `OPTIONS_COMPUTED` | Optional (skipped in validation if FACEBOOKMESSENGER) | Facebook user account |
| `FACEBOOK_PAGE` | `OPTIONS_COMPUTED` | Yes | Facebook page to connect |
| `CURRENT_STATUS` | `SYSTEM_DEFINED` | — | Tracks page status |
| `name` | `STRING` | Yes | Channel display name |

**Important:** For `FACEBOOKMESSENGER`, if `FACEBOOK_USER` is required per configParams, the `validate()` function **skips** its required check (the page is what matters, not the user). This is a hardcoded override:
```js
if (isFbMessenger && name === FACEBOOK_USER) {
  continue; // skip validation for this field
}
```

### 9.3 OAuth / Page connection flow

Same as Instagram. `FacebookPagesListContainer` → `useFBMessenger` hook → Facebook SDK widget → page selection.

**Page actions:** Same as Instagram (`addpage`, `enablepermission`, `reauth`)

### 9.4 Widget features

After page connection (`pageStatus === PAGE_ADDED`):
- **Message Widget tab** appears in edit view
- Widget embed code / button snippet available
- Widget can be customised (colours, text)

### 9.5 Validation

- `FACEBOOK_PAGE`: Required
- Channel name: required + regex
- `FACEBOOK_USER`: NOT validated even if marked required (by design)

### 9.6 Error cases

| Condition | Message |
|---|---|
| Permission revoked — Meta | `zohoim.messenger.page.permission.revoked.no.operation` |
| Permission revoked — WeCom | `zohoim.wecom.page.permission.revoked.no.operation` |
| Auth expired | `zohoim.messenger.page.auth.expired.no.operation` |
| Page action cancelled | `zohoim.messenger.page.action.addpage.cancelled` |
| Access denied | `zohoim.facebook.page.action.access_denied` |

### 9.7 Success case

Same as Instagram.

### 9.8 Edit page tabs

`CHANNEL_INFO`, `CHANNEL_AGENTS_ASSOCIATION` + `MESSAGE_WIDGET` (when `pageStatus === 'PAGE_ADDED'`)

## 10. Channel: IM Talk (Business Messaging)

**App name constant:** `IM_TALK` (`IMTALK_APPNAME`)

### 10.1 Component files

Uses shared `ChannelFormInfo` + `ChannelFormInfoContainer`.  
Identified as a ZBM (Zoho Business Messaging) channel via `isZBMChannel(integrationServiceId)`.

### 10.2 Form fields

Fetched entirely from `GET /api/v1/im/integrationServices/IM_TALK`. Includes:
- Channel `name` (STRING, required)
- IM_TALK-specific configParams from API

### 10.3 Validation

- Standard required-field check per configParams
- Channel name check

### 10.4 Special features

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| ZBM channel flag | `isZBMChannel('IM_TALK') === true` → enables **Channel Widget Customization** tab on edit |
| Prefilled messages | Can set a prefilled message for conversations initiated via the widget |
| Communication modes | Available if the platform supports it |

### 10.5 Error cases

Generic API errors → toast via `showSuccessFailureMessage`.

### 10.6 Success case

Same standard flow.

### 10.7 Edit page tabs

`CHANNEL_INFO`, `CHANNEL_AGENTS_ASSOCIATION`, **`CHANNEL_WIDGET_CUSTOMIZATION`** (ZBM only), `MESSAGE_WIDGET`

## 11. Common API & Submission Flow

### 11.1 Create Channel

```
POST /api/v1/im/channels
Content-Type: application/json

Response: { "id": "channelId", ... channelConfig }
```

### 11.2 Update Channel

```
PATCH /api/v1/im/channels/:channelId
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Updated Name",
  "configParams": [/* only modified fields */]
}
```

### 11.3 Upload channel photo

Called after create/update when a file is selected:
```
POST /api/v1/im/channels/:channelCode/photo
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Body: { file }
```
Success toast: `zohoim.channel.pic.updated`

### 11.4 Department association

```
PATCH /api/v1/im/channels/:channelId/department
Body: { departmentId }
```

Called in parallel with photo upload using `Promise.all`.
### 11.5 Complete submission state machine

```
User clicks Submit
    │
    ▼
validate() — client-side
    │
    ├─ FAIL → scroll to first error field, show inline error, stop
    │
    └─ PASS
         │
         ▼
     setState({ submitStatus: 'loading' })   ← button shows spinner
         │
         ▼
     POST /api/v1/im/channels
         │
         ├─ SUCCESS ──────────────────────────────┐

│                                        ▼
         │                                  Promise.all([
         │                                    updateDepartment  (if changed),
         │                                    uploadPhoto       (if file selected)
         │                                  ])
         │                                        │

│                          ┌─────────────┴──────────────┐
         │                     SUCCESS                          FAIL
         │                          │                             │
         │                          ▼                             ▼
         │               submitStatus: 'success'         submitStatus: 'none'

│               agentAssociationAlert: true      show error toast
         │               navigate to channel list
         │
         └─ FAIL → submitStatus: 'none', show error toast
```

## 12. Edit Page Tabs Per Channel

Determined by `ChannelFormLayoutContainer` — [src/containers/ChannelFormLayoutContainer/ChannelFormLayoutContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/containers/ChannelFormLayoutContainer/ChannelFormLayoutContainer.js)

```js
// Logic from supportedLayoutOptions useMemo

| Channel | Creation tabs | Edit tabs |
|---|---|---|
| **WhatsApp** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, BUSINESS_INFO, COMMUNICATION_MODES\*, MESSAGE_WIDGET |
| **Telegram** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, MESSAGE_WIDGET |
| **LINE** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, MESSAGE_WIDGET |
| **WeChat** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, MESSAGE_WIDGET |

| **WeCom** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, MESSAGE_WIDGET |
| **Instagram** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, MESSAGE_WIDGET† |
| **Facebook Messenger** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, MESSAGE_WIDGET† |
| **IM Talk** | CHANNEL_INFO | CHANNEL_INFO, AGENTS, CHANNEL_WIDGET_CUSTOMIZATION, MESSAGE_WIDGET |

\* Only when `isWhatsAppCallsEnabled` is true  
† Only when `pageStatus === PAGE_ADDED`

## 1. Overview & Architecture

The reply area is a state machine. Rendering is determined by two values:

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| `sessionStatus` | Session entity — lifecycle phase of the conversation |
| `replyStatus` (`sessionReplyStatus`) | Channel-level capability — whether the channel allows sending |

These flow through two layers:

**Layer 1 — `ChatFooterContainer`** (outer shell)
- Checks `sessionStatus` first
- Computes `canReply`, `canPickup`, `needPickUp`, `needEnd`
- Decides whether to show a full-width toast OR pass through to `ReplyPartContainer`

**Layer 2 — `ReplyPartContainer` + `useReplyPartUIHeaderAndFooter`** (inner shell)
- Receives computed flags as props
- Decides whether to show the text editor or a restriction message
- Renders the correct footer buttons

**Render priority in outer layer (first match wins):**

```
1. sessionStatus === BLOCKED          → "Unblock User" toast
2. needPickUp (no assignee / BOT)     → "Pick Up" toast
3. sessionStatus === ENDED (non-IMTalk) → "Reopen" toast
4. everything else                    → ReplyPartContainer
```

## 2. Session Status — All Values
**File:** [packages/client-sdk/src/domain/enum/session/SessionStatus.js](jsapps/imclient/packages/client-sdk/src/domain/enum/session/SessionStatus.js)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `CREATED` | Session created, not yet open |
| `OPEN` | Session is live and active |
| `ON_PROGRESS` | Being actively processed |
| `ON_HOLD` | Placed on hold by agent |
| `ENDED` | Conversation closed |
| `BLOCKED` | End user blocked |
| `UNASSIGNED` | No agent assigned |

> `sessionStatus` drives only the **outer** toast layer. For normal active states (`CREATED`, `OPEN`, `ON_PROGRESS`, `ON_HOLD`) the reply area behavior is fully controlled by `replyStatus`.

## 4. Master Decision Logic (from source)

From [ChatFooterContainer.js](jsapps/imclient/src/features/reply_area/frameworks/react/containers/ChatFooterContainer/ChatFooterContainer.js):
const isSessionBlocked       = sessionStatus === 'BLOCKED';
const needEnd = needEndForIMTalk || requiresEndForInstaFbWeChat;

**isRenderEditor** (determines whether the text input is shown or replaced by restriction toast):
```js
const isRenderEditor = !!(canReply || canSendTemplateMessage);
// canSendTemplateMessage = component state, true only when a template has been SELECTED
```

### 5.1 SESSION STATUS: BLOCKED

**Trigger:** `sessionStatus === 'BLOCKED'`

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Layer | Outer toast (ChatFooterContainer) |
| Editor | Hidden (full-width toast replaces everything) |
| Restriction msg | _(not a restriction toast — it's a standalone ConversationToast)_ |
| Button | **Unblock User** |

**Unblock User API:**
```
Action: changeSessionStatus()
PATCH   /api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId
Body:   { status: 'OPEN', agentId: (currentUserId if no current assignee, else '') }
```

---

### 5.2 SESSION STATUS: needPickUp (no assignee OR BOT assigned)

**Trigger:**
```js
(!sessionAssigneeId && !isOtherServiceSession) || sessionAssigneeType === BOT
&& !isIMTalkSessionEnded
```
Applies to `sessionStatus`: CREATED, OPEN, ON_PROGRESS, ON_HOLD, UNASSIGNED — any non-ended state where the session has no agent or has a BOT.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Layer | Outer toast (ChatFooterContainer) |
| Editor | Hidden (full-width toast) |
| Button | **Pick Up** |

**Pick Up — if `sessionAssigneeType === BOT` or `isAssignedToOtherService` prop is truthy:**
```
Action: assignChatToAgent()
POST    /api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId/assignee
Body:   { agentId: currentUserId }
```

**Pick Up — otherwise (genuinely unassigned):**
```
Action: pickupSession()
POST    /api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId/pickup
```

### 5.3 SESSION STATUS: ENDED (non-IMTalk channels)

**Trigger:** `sessionStatus === 'ENDED'` and channel is NOT `IM_TALK`

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Layer | Outer toast (ChatFooterContainer) |
| Editor | Hidden |
| Button | **Reopen** |

**Reopen API:**

PATCH   /api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId
Body:   { status: 'ON_HOLD', agentId: currentUserId }

### 5.4 SESSION STATUS: ENDED — IMTalk only

**Trigger:** `sessionStatus === 'ENDED'` and channel is `IM_TALK`

IMTalk ended sessions skip the outer "Reopen" toast and fall into `ReplyPartContainer`.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Layer | ReplyPartContainer (inner) |
| Editor | Hidden (isRenderEditor = false) |
| Restriction msg | `'zohoim.chat.reply.bm.session.ended'` |
| Buttons | **None** |

> Cannot end or reopen from here. Session is already closed.

### 5.5 REPLY STATUS: ACCEPTED — current agent

**Trigger:** `replyStatus === 'ACCEPTED'` and `isCurrentAgentChat === true`

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Layer | ReplyPartContainer |
| Editor | **Enabled** (full text input) |
| Buttons | **Send**, **Send and Close** |

**Send message:**
```
POST  /api/v1/im/:sessionId/messages
Body: { messageText, sessionId, conversations, sessionAssignee, ... }

**Send attachment:**

PATCH /api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId       ← then closes
Body: { status: 'ENDED', agentId }
```

## 6. Footer Button Rendering (renderChatFooter logic)

From [useReplyPartUIHeaderAndFooter.js](jsapps/imclient/src/features/reply_area/frameworks/react/hooks/ReplyPart/hooks/useReplyPartUIHeaderAndFooter.js):

```js
const renderChatFooter = () => {

| Button | When shown | API |
|---|---|---|
| **Send** | `canReply` or template selected, not disabled | `POST /api/v1/im/:sessionId/messages` |
| **Send and Close** | Same as Send | Send message then `PATCH sessions/:id { status: ENDED }` |
| **Cancel** | Template mode (`canSendTemplateMessage = true` state) | Resets template selection, no API |

| **Send Template** | `isWhatsAppNeededTemplates` (WhatsApp, non-sandbox, expired) | `POST /api/v1/im/:sessionId/messages` with template payload |
| **End Chat** | `needEnd` (IMTalk offline / Insta/FB/WeChat expired) or disabled | `PATCH /api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId { status: ENDED }` |

| **Pick Up** (inner) | `canPickup` (NOT_AN_ASSIGNEE / ASSIGNED_TO_OTHER_SERVICE / expired not-current-agent) | `POST .../assignee` or `POST .../pickup` |
| **Unblock User** | Outer toast: `sessionStatus === BLOCKED` | `PATCH sessions/:id { status: OPEN }` |
| **Pick Up** (outer) | Outer toast: no assignee or BOT | `POST .../assignee` or `POST .../pickup` |
| **Reopen** | Outer toast: `sessionStatus === ENDED` (non-IMTalk) | `PATCH sessions/:id { status: ON_HOLD }` |

## 7. API Reference

Base: `/api/v1/im`

| Action | Method | Path | Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| Send text message | POST | `/api/v1/im/:sessionId/messages` | `{ messageText, sessionId, ... }` |
| Send template message | POST | `/api/v1/im/:sessionId/messages` | `{ additionalObj: { type: 'templates', data: {...} } }` |
| Send attachment | POST | `/api/v1/im/:sessionId/attachments` | FormData |

| End session | PATCH | `/api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId` | `{ status: 'ENDED', agentId }` |
| Reopen session | PATCH | `/api/v1/im/sessions/:sessionId` | `{ status: 'ON_HOLD', agentId }` |
